name: EPIC 206090304
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 8.3 solar radii and 0.84 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206090304 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.299552 (16th-84th percentiles 8.134428-8.530095), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206090304 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.837354 (16th-84th percentiles 0.801154-0.892429), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206090304: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4656.777 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206090304 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1059.863281 (16th-84th percentiles 1042.607422-1080.458984), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.07 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,060 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.84 solar masses and 8.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,657 K at its surface.
